name: Bamboo shoot with garlic
summary: Măng vầu xào tỏi is măng vầu bamboo shoot stir-fried with garlic, from the same Xá Phó home meal in Nậm Sang.
origin: Xá Phó households of thôn Nậm Sang, xã Nậm Sài.
howToEat: Share it with cá lam ống and the meat-and-bamboo stir-fry.
where: Xá Phó houses in thôn Nậm Sang, about 2.5 km from the Nậm Sài commune center and about 30 km south of town. It is a home meal, not a restaurant.
seoTitle: Garlic bamboo shoot at Nam Sang
seoDescription: Măng vầu xào tỏi, bamboo shoot stir-fried with garlic, at a Xá Phó home meal in thôn Nậm Sang.
